_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'PROBABILITY AND IMPACT ASSESSMENT' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.08.03.

f01_Probability_Scoring_Scales_and_Value.label: Probability Scoring Scales and Values
f01_Probability_Scoring_Scales_and_Value.guidance: The 1 to 5 numerical scale and percentage probability ranges applied.

f02_Impact_Scoring_Scales_and_Dimensions.label: Impact Scoring Scales and Dimensions
f02_Impact_Scoring_Scales_and_Dimensions.guidance: The 1 to 5 rating scale defining scope, schedule, cost, and quality severity.

f03_Risk_ID_and_Event_Title.label: Risk ID and Event Title
f03_Risk_ID_and_Event_Title.guidance: The unique risk tracking identifier and concise description of the risk event.

f04_Evaluated_Probability_and_Impact_Rat.label: Evaluated Probability and Impact Ratings
f04_Evaluated_Probability_and_Impact_Rat.guidance: Individual probability score and assessed impact rating across project dimensions.

f05_Risk_Urgency_and_Proximity_Assessmen.label: Risk Urgency and Proximity Assessment
f05_Risk_Urgency_and_Proximity_Assessmen.guidance: Time proximity and urgency factor determining how quickly a response is needed.

f06_Composite_Risk_Exposure_Score.label: Composite Risk Exposure Score
f06_Composite_Risk_Exposure_Score.guidance: Calculated overall risk score (Probability x Impact) placing the risk on the priority ladder.

f07_Priority_Category_and_Mitigation_Urg.label: Priority Category and Mitigation Urgency
f07_Priority_Category_and_Mitigation_Urg.guidance: Classification into High (Red), Moderate (Yellow), or Low (Green) priority bands.
